verdict.rationale: Asking whether a data platform's source is readable under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows Databricks publishes its platform source under an open license. Mentions of Apache Spark, dbt Core, and 'open' sharing or marketplace features are about adjacent or third-party components, not the product's own source. One community comment says Databricks keeps its scale optimizations proprietary, consistent with the absence of open-source evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
